title: Trip to the Zoo
description: A fun adventure to the zoo

fields.prompt: What's the name of an animal?

template:
{name} took a trip to the zoo.  {name.pronoun | capitalizeFirst} saw many animals and had a great time.  There was {adjective.article} {adjective} {animal}.

The {animal} was named {name2}.  {name2} was {verb.ingTense}.
